answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 47474 Country: AF Title: Sawm Question: If someone does an action that breaks fasting in Ramadan so he or she brings the qaza of that fasting, is he or she still aasi (sinful) or how much sin is on him or her? Answer ID: 47474 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1308/900/L=11/1434) The question does not mention the act by which fast breaks; hence we cannot say anything about it whether only qaza shall be made or kaffarah as well. As far as the matter of being sinful after doing qaza is concerned; so since a man is free from his responsibility after making qaza, but he or she will have to do taubah and istighfar for the offence of missing fast. Only qaza is not enough. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
